# sensory property

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sensoryProperty`](gmeow-sensoryProperty.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sensoryProperty>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory`](../../slices/sensory.md)

The observable property that a sensory observation measures — temperature, humidity, light intensity, etc. Distinct from [`gmeow:observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) (the procedure or protocol used); this names the property itself. A sensory observation concerns exactly one observable property per observation; multiple properties require multiple observations ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryObservation.md) -> [`gmeow:ObservableProperty`](../classes/gmeow-ObservableProperty.md)

Use [`gmeow:sensoryProperty`](gmeow-sensoryProperty.md) from [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryObservation.md) to [`gmeow:ObservableProperty`](../classes/gmeow-ObservableProperty.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
